transactions._comment: Stage 2 of the staged funding plan -- sends the remaining 0.493084308357578318 ETH, which together with stage 1's 0.2 ETH (docs/safe-tx-fund-v1claim-stage1.json) sums to EXACTLY the original total budget (0.693084308357578318 ETH, data/snapshot/v1_claim_eth_meta.json), no more, no less. Sign this whenever -- there's no deadline pressure on when stage 2 lands, only on when the claim window itself closes (contract deadline(), 2026-10-11 19:13:17 UTC). Safe to send even if some holders have already partially or fully claimed from stage 1's funds: the contract's receive() has no logic, so this just tops up whatever balance remains.
